summary: Path identity is Git's, compared exactly as Git reports it, and a run that produces a candidate does not complete until that candidate is committed: confinement must see a path that differs only by whitespace, and terminal completion must refuse an uncommitted candidate.
plan: Two repairs, both in the governed loop. FIRST, exact Git path identity. Add an authoritative changed-path source in internal/gitx/git.go: a ChangeSet of FileChange{Path, OldPath, Status} produced from `git diff --no-ext-diff --name-status -z` against the pinned base, parsed on NUL boundaries so no pathname Git can produce is lost or split, both sides of a rename preserved, deterministic order after parsing. In internal/workflow/engine.go obtain that ChangeSet and reconcile it against report.FromDiff(diff) at BOTH existing binding points -- immediately after the read-only (ModeInspect) refusal over the worker's diff, and immediately after e.validate returns over the diff validation re-read -- comparing path sets, statuses and rename old paths, and refusing the candidate the way the ModeInspect refusal does, naming the disagreement, before validation, the prospective inspection, the test-edit inspection, the audit, the Level-1 classification, the review or admission sees it. Change confineToPlan in internal/workflow/testedit.go to take the authoritative changed paths (rename old paths included) and the plan's named files, and to compare them EXACTLY as Git reports them: no strings.TrimSpace on either side, no case folding, no separator rewriting. The plan's own spelling may be canonicalised only by path.Clean, which must not be applied in any way that maps two distinct paths onto one; ` internal/workflow/engine.go` and `internal/workflow/engine.go` are different files and a candidate touching the first against a plan naming the second is refused. It must not take or read test-edit grants. Repair internal/report/report.go so FromDiff parses Git-quoted headers ("a/…" and "b/…" with C-style escapes) and reports those files, keeping it a renderer and never the source of pathname authority. SECOND, candidate commitment. In runCandidate in internal/workflow/engine.go, a run that produced a candidate must not reach terminal completion while that candidate is uncommitted: after the review resolves and before the terminal completion path, if the candidate worktree holds uncommitted changes the run refuses with an error naming them, rather than reporting the candidate ready for governed admission. A run that produced no candidate at all is unaffected. Tests in internal/gitx/git_test.go: a non-ASCII path, a path containing a tab, a path with leading and with trailing whitespace, a rename with a quoted old path and one with a quoted new path, a deletion of a quoted path, and an ordinary ASCII control, each appearing in ChangeSet with the right status and both rename sides. Tests in internal/report/report_test.go: FromDiff reports quoted and escaped paths, and the ASCII control still parses. Tests in internal/workflow/engine_test.go: a path differing from a planned one only by a leading space is refused; the same for a trailing space; a quoted out-of-plan modification is refused; a quoted out-of-plan deletion is refused; a rename whose old path is outside the plan is refused; a disagreement between report.FromDiff and the authoritative ChangeSet refuses before any downstream consumer; an in-plan candidate still passes; confinement still refuses at both binding points including a formatter that widens the candidate during validation; and a candidate left uncommitted does not reach terminal completion. No other behaviour changes; no new files.
steps: Add ChangeSet, FileChange and Status to internal/gitx/git.go from `git diff --no-ext-diff --name-status -z`, parsed on NUL boundaries.
Change confineToPlan in internal/workflow/testedit.go to take authoritative changed paths and compare them exactly, with no TrimSpace on either side and no grant input.

In runCandidate in internal/workflow/engine.go, obtain the ChangeSet, reconcile against report.FromDiff at both binding points, refuse on disagreement, and pass the authoritative paths to confineToPlan.
In runCandidate, refuse terminal completion when a produced candidate is left uncommitted, naming the uncommitted paths.
Repair report.FromDiff in internal/report/report.go for Git-quoted and escaped path headers, keeping it a renderer.
Add the tests named in the plan to internal/gitx/git_test.go, internal/report/report_test.go and internal/workflow/engine_test.go.
Run gofmt -l cmd internal, go vet ./..., and go test ./... .
consequences: A candidate that changes a path Git quotes, or one differing from a planned path only by whitespace, is refused instead of invisible; a disagreement between the textual patch and Git's own path list refuses the candidate before any authority decision; and a run that produced a candidate cannot report it ready for governed admission while it remains uncommitted. Candidates whose paths are ordinary, inside their plan, and committed behave exactly as before. The artifact boundary in internal/gitx/capture.go is out of scope.

claims.statement: confineToPlan canonicalises both sides with path.Clean(strings.TrimSpace(...)), so a path differing from a planned one only by surrounding whitespace is accepted.
report.FromDiff recognises only unquoted `diff --git a/P b/P` and `+++ b/P` headers, so a Git-quoted path yields no FileChange.
runCandidate reaches workflow completion on review acceptance without requiring the candidate worktree to be committed.
